title: Tradition
description: A tradition card, placed in a typed slot. One file per tradition in content/traditions/<id>.json.

slot.description: The slot type that takes the card.

effects.description: The effects while the card is slotted.

style.description: For architectural-style cards, the key the view maps to a mesh variant set.

start.description: Whether the tradition is available from the start without an unlockTradition effect.
